shorts.title: The sleepy fox finds its den

shots.visual: A small fox cub sits yawning on a mossy path under early stars; Pip bobs into frame and its glow brightens.
shots.voiceover: Little fox, it's late. Pip will light the way.

shots.visual: Pip walks ahead along the path, the cub padding behind, the glow catching ferns and a toadstool.
shots.voiceover: Past the ferns. Past the toadstool. Nearly there.

shots.visual: They cross a small wooden bridge over a dark stream; two tiny moths circle Pip's glow.
shots.voiceover: Over the bridge. The moths say hello.

shots.visual: The cub curls into a den under tree roots; Pip's glow softens to an ember.
shots.voiceover: Home. Goodnight, little fox.

shorts.cta: Goodnight from Pip. One little light every day.

shorts.title: Five fireflies

shots.visual: A dark meadow; one firefly blinks on beside Pip, whose glow brightens in reply.
shots.voiceover: One firefly. Can you see it?

shots.visual: A second, third and fourth firefly blink on one at a time around Pip, Pip bobbing once for each.
shots.voiceover: Two. Three. Four.

shots.visual: A fifth firefly lands on Pip's tin cap; all five glow together.
shots.voiceover: Five! Five fireflies.

shots.visual: The fireflies drift up into the stars; Pip dims.
shots.voiceover: Five fireflies, off to bed.

shorts.cta: Goodnight from Pip. One little light every day.

shorts.title: Why does the moon follow you?
shorts.hook_text: Why does the moon follow you?

shots.visual: Pip walks a meadow path and keeps glancing up at a big soft moon that seems to move with it; Pip tilts its cap.
shots.on_screen_text: Why does the moon follow you?
shots.voiceover: Pip walks. The moon walks too. Why?

shots.visual: Pip passes a close toadstool and a near tree; they slide by quickly while the moon stays still.
shots.voiceover: Close things slide past fast.

shots.visual: A far hill with a single tree barely moves as Pip walks on; the moon above it stays put.
shots.voiceover: Far things hardly move at all.

shots.visual: Pip stops, looks straight up at the moon, glow softening.
shots.camera: slow tilt up to the moon
shots.on_screen_text: The moon is very, very far.
shots.voiceover: The moon is so far, it looks like it follows. Now you know.

shorts.cta: Goodnight from Pip. One little light every day.

shorts.title: Putting the toys to bed
shorts.hook_text: Time to say goodnight to the toys.

shots.visual: A felt bear, a wooden boat and a ball lie scattered on a mossy clearing; Pip bobs in and glows.
shots.on_screen_text: Time to say goodnight to the toys.
shots.voiceover: The toys are tired too.

shots.visual: Pip nudges the ball with its glow and it rolls gently into a hollow log; the bear is tucked under a big leaf.
shots.voiceover: Ball in the log. Bear under the leaf.

shots.visual: The little boat floats to the edge of a still pond and rests against a stone.
shots.voiceover: Boat by the stone. All tidy.

shots.visual: The clearing is neat; Pip sits in the middle and dims.
shots.voiceover: Goodnight, toys. Goodnight, you.

shorts.cta: Goodnight from Pip. One little light every day.

shorts.title: Three red toadstools

shots.visual: One red toadstool with white spots at the foot of a tree; Pip glows beside it.
shots.voiceover: One red toadstool.

shots.visual: Pip walks on; a second and third red toadstool appear along the roots.
shots.voiceover: Two red. Three red.

shots.visual: All three toadstools in a row, Pip bobbing happily between them.
shots.voiceover: Three red toadstools.

shots.visual: Pip dims under the tree; the red caps fade into the dusk.
shots.voiceover: Red. Goodnight, toadstools.

shorts.cta: Goodnight from Pip. One little light every day.

shorts.title: When the dark feels big

shots.visual: A tiny hedgehog curled tight under a bush in deep dusk; Pip's glow arrives slowly.
shots.voiceover: The dark felt big. Pip came close.

shots.visual: Pip's glow swells slowly and shrinks slowly, like breathing; the hedgehog uncurls a little.
shots.voiceover: Breathe in with the light. And out.

shots.visual: In the glow, the bush becomes friendly: a snail, a leaf, a drop of dew.
shots.voiceover: See? A snail. A leaf. A drop of dew.

shots.visual: The hedgehog settles, Pip stays close and dims to an ember.
shots.on_screen_text: The dark is just the day resting.
shots.voiceover: The dark is just the day resting. Pip stays.

shorts.cta: Goodnight from Pip. One little light every day.

shorts.title: The first autumn leaf
shorts.hook_text: One little light for a leaf.

shots.visual: A single golden leaf lets go of a branch and drifts down; Pip looks up and glows.
shots.camera: slow tilt down following the leaf
shots.on_screen_text: One little light for a leaf.
shots.voiceover: The first leaf of autumn. Pip will walk it home.

shots.visual: The leaf floats down the stream; Pip walks the bank beside it.
shots.voiceover: Down the stream, round the bend.

shots.visual: The leaf comes to rest on a soft pile of other leaves under a round-topped tree.
shots.voiceover: There. With all the others.

shots.visual: Pip sits on the leaf pile and dims; a few more leaves drift down.
shots.voiceover: Goodnight, little leaf. Goodnight, autumn.

shorts.cta: Goodnight from Pip. One little light every day.
